# AppConsoleOutputType

The kind of console output an app printed.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Normal"` | Ordinary output, from `Print` and `PrintLine`. |
| `"Trace"` | Diagnostic output, from `Trace` and `TraceLine`. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`AppConsoleOutput`](app-console-output.md)
